desc:
👍 THUMBS UP for NEW MAPS! 👍
👥 JOIN THE GROUP for 200 FREE 💎 — claim it at the present in the lobby!

You’re snowed in! Dig out of the garage with a tiny spoon, then work your way up to a roaring Snowblower.

Team up with friends and clear the whole map!

How to play:
🥄 Scoop snow into your bag
🔥 Melt it at a fire to earn cash
🛒 Buy a Snow Shovel and a Snowblower, upgrade them on your laptop
🧊 Clear each zone to thaw the gate to the next
🛷 Hop on a sled with friends and clear it together
💎 Earn gems for upgrades and skills in the lobby
🏆 Beat Easy to unlock Medium, then Hard

🎁 Come back every day for a free gift!
📊 Top the boards for the fastest clear and the most snow
